decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:Location and Block Plan - GA001Existing Site Plan - GA010Proposed Site Plan - GA011Proposed Elevations Plan - GA-101Proposed Roof Plan - GA-100Article 13 NoticeV-TAC Lighting Specification SheetPlanning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to above ground works on the development hereby permitted, external materials specification and detailed drawings (1:20 and 1:5) including Kingspan side cladding specified - colour to be confirmed, ideally accompanied by 3D views to show sensitivity to views from Firs Lane, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the finished appearance of the development will respect the character and visual amenities of the local area.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on Council's webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and maintained as such thereafter.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk and to minimise discharge of surface water unto the Metropolitan Open Land in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, Policies SI 12 & SI 13 of the London Plan (2021) and the NPPF (2024).

No development shall take place until a revised acoustic report, written in line with the methodology in BS4142:2014+A1 2019, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The report must set out the sound level that would be generated from the proposed padel court, including noise from use of the padel rackets as well as noise at the façade of the nearest or most noise affected residential property.Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise and disturbance

The granted development shall not be operational as a padel court before 09:00am or after 10:00pm Monday to Friday or before 09:00am or after 09:00pm on weekends and public holidays. Any activity associated with the stated use shall cease within 1 hour of the closing time specified above.   Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties
